phrases.def: 更大的目的 一路走来

sentences.en: Animal migration, however it is defined, is far more than just the movement of animals It can loosely be described as travel that takes place at regular intervals - often in an annual cycle that may involve many members of a species, and is rewarded only after a long journey.
sentences.zh: 动物迁徙,无论如何定义,都不仅仅是动物的移动,它可以粗略地描述为定期发生的旅行——通常以每年一次的周期进行,可能涉及一个物种的许多成员,并且只有在长途旅行后才会得到回报。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It suggests inherited instinct.
sentences.zh: 这表明遗传的本能。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The biologist Hugh Dingle has identified five characteristics that apply, in varying degrees and combinations, to all migrations.
sentences.zh: 生物学家休·丁格尔（Hugh Dingle）确定了五个特征,这些特征以不同程度和组合适用于所有迁徙。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They are prolonged movements that carry animals outside familiar habitats; they tend to be linear, not zigzaggy; they involve special behaviours concerning preparation (such as overfeeding) and arrival; they demand special allocations of energy And one more: migrating animals maintain an intense attentiveness to the greater mission, which keeps them undistracted by temptations and undeterred by challenges that would turn other animals aside.
sentences.zh: 它们是将动物带到熟悉的栖息地之外的长时间运动；它们往往是线性的,而不是锯齿形的；它们涉及与准备（例如过量喂食）和到达有关的特殊行为；它们需要特殊的能量分配,还有一个：迁徙的动物对更伟大的使命保持着强烈的关注,这使它们不会被诱惑分心,也不会被会使其他动物抛开的挑战吓倒。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: An arctic tern, on its 20,000 km flight from the extreme south of South America to the Arctic circle, will take no notice of a nice smelly herring offered from a bird-watcher's boat along the way.
sentences.zh: 一只北极燕鸥在从南美洲最南端飞往北极圈的 20,000 公里飞行中,不会注意到沿途观鸟者的船上提供的一条臭味十足的鲱鱼。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: While local gulls will dive voraciously for such handouts, the tern flies on. Why?
sentences.zh: 当当地的海鸥会贪婪地潜水以获得这些施舍时,燕鸥却继续飞翔。为什么？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The arctic tern resists distraction because it is driven at that moment by an instinctive sense of something we humans find admirable: larger purpose.
sentences.zh: 北极燕鸥拒绝分心,因为在那一刻,它受到一种我们人类认为令人钦佩的本能感觉的驱使：更大的目标。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In other words, it is determined to reach its destination.
sentences.zh: 换句话说,确定到达目的地。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The bird senses that it can eat, rest and mate later.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿感觉到它可以进食、休息并稍后交配。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Right now it is totally focused on the journey; its undivided intent is arrival.
sentences.zh: 现在完全专注于旅程；它的唯一目的是到来。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Reaching some gravelly coastline in the Arctic, upon which other arctic terns have converged, will serve its larger purpose as shaped by evolution: finding a place, a time, and a set of circumstances in which it can successfully hatch and rear offspring.
sentences.zh: 到达北极的一些砾石海岸线,那里有其他北极燕鸥聚集的地方,将实现其进化所塑造的更大目标：找到一个地点、时间和一系列环境,使其能够成功孵化和养育后代。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: But migration is a complex issue, and biologists define it differently, depending in part on what sort of animals they study.
sentences.zh: 但是迁徙是一个复杂的问题,生物学家对它的定义不同,部分取决于他们研究的动物种类。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Joel Berger, of the University of Montana, who works on the American pronghorn and other large terrestrial mammals, prefers what he calls a simple, practical definition suited to his beasts: 'movements from a seasonal home area away to another home area and back again'.
sentences.zh: 蒙大拿大学的乔尔·伯杰（Joel Berger）从事美洲叉角羚和其他大型陆生哺乳动物的研究,他更喜欢一个适合他的动物的简单实用的定义：“从季节性栖息地到另一个栖息地然后再返回的运动”。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Generally the reason for such seasonal back-and-forth movement is to seek resources that aren't available within a single area year-round.
sentences.zh: 一般来说,这种季节性来回移动的原因是为了寻找单个区域全年无法获得的资源。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But daily vertical movements by zooplankton in the ocean - upward by night to seek food, downward by day to escape predators can also be considered migration.
sentences.zh: 但是海洋中浮游动物的日常垂直运动——夜间向上寻找食物,白天向下躲避捕食者也可以被视为迁徙。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: So can the movement of aphids when, having depleted the young leaves on one food plant, their offspring then fly onward to a different host plant, with no one aphid ever returning to where it started.
sentences.zh: 蚜虫的运动也是如此,当它们耗尽一株食用植物的幼叶后,它们的后代就会飞向另一株寄主植物,而没有一只蚜虫会回到它开始的地方。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Dingle is an evolutionary biologist who studies insects.
sentences.zh: 丁格尔是一位研究昆虫的进化生物学家。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: His definition is more intricate than Berger's, citing those five features that distinguish migration from other forms of movement.
sentences.zh: 他的定义比伯杰的更复杂,引用了区分移民与其他形式的运动的五个特征。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: They allow for the fact that, for example, aphids will become sensitive to blue light (from the sky) when it's time for takeoff on their big journey, and sensitive to yellow light (reflected from tender young leaves) when it's appropriate to land.
sentences.zh: 他们考虑到这样一个事实,例如,当蚜虫在长途旅行时会对蓝光（来自天空）敏感,而当适合着陆时对黄光（从嫩嫩的叶子反射）敏感。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Birds will fatten themselves with heavy feeding in advance of a long migrational flight.
sentences.zh: 鸟类在长途迁徙飞行之前会通过大量喂食来使自己变胖。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The value of his definition, Dingle argues, is that it focuses attention on what the phenomenon of wildebeest migration shares with the phenomenon of the aphids, and therefore helps guide researchers towards understanding how evolution has produced them all.
sentences.zh: 丁格尔认为,他的定义的价值在于,它将注意力集中在角马迁徙现象与蚜虫现象的共同点上,因此有助于指导研究人员理解进化是如何产生它们的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Human behaviour, however, is having a detrimental impact on animal migration.
sentences.zh: 然而,人类行为正在对动物迁徙产生有害影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The pronghorn, which resembles an antelope, though they are unrelated, is the fastest land mammal of the New World.
sentences.zh: 叉角羚虽然与羚羊无关,但与羚羊相似,是新大陆跑得最快的陆地哺乳动物。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: One population, which spends the summer in the mountainous Grand Teton National Park of the western USA, follows a narrow route from its summer range in the mountains, across a river, and down onto the plains.
sentences.zh: 一个种群在美国西部多山的大提顿国家公园度过夏季,沿着一条狭窄的路线从山区的夏季活动范围出发,穿过河流,到达平原。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Here they wait out the frozen months, feeding mainly on sagebrush blown clear of snow.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里等待冰冻月份的结束,主要以被雪吹走的山艾树为食。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: These pronghorn are notable for the invariance of their migration route and the severity of its constriction at three bottlenecks.
sentences.zh: 这些叉角羚因其迁徙路线的不变性和三个瓶颈处的严重收缩而引人注目。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: If they can't pass through each of the three during their spring migration, they can't reach their bounty of summer grazing; if they can't pass through again in autumn, escaping south onto those windblown plains, they are likely to die trying to overwinter in the deep snow.
sentences.zh: 如果它们在春季迁徙时不能通过这三个区域中的每一个,它们就无法到达夏季放牧的赏金；如果他们不能在秋天再次穿越,向南逃到那些被风吹过的平原上,他们很可能会在厚厚的积雪中过冬时死去。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Pronghorn, dependent on distance vision and speed to keep safe from predators, traverse high, open shoulders of land, where they can see and run.
sentences.zh: 叉角羚依靠远距离视力和速度来躲避捕食者,它们会穿越高处、开阔的地肩,在那里它们可以看到并奔跑。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: At one of the bottlenecks, forested hills rise to form a V, leaving a corridor of open ground only about 150 metres wide, filled with private homes.
sentences.zh: 在其中一个瓶颈处,森林覆盖的山丘升起,形成一个 V 字形,留下一条仅约 150 米宽的空地走廊,里面布满了私人住宅。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Increasing development is leading toward a crisis for the pronghorn, threatening to choke off their passageway.
sentences.zh: 叉角羚的日益发展正面临着危机,威胁着它们的通道。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Conservation scientists, along with some biologists and land managers within the USA's National Park Service and other agencies, are now working to preserve migrational behaviours, not just species and habitats.
sentences.zh: 保护科学家以及美国国家公园管理局和其他机构内的一些生物学家和土地管理者现在正在努力保护迁徙行为,而不仅仅是物种和栖息地。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A National Forest has recognised the path of the pronghorn, much of which passes across its land, as a protected migration corridor.
sentences.zh: 国家森林已将叉角羚的路径（其中大部分穿过其土地）视为受保护的迁徙走廊。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: But neither the Forest Service nor the Park Service can control what happens on private land at a bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 但是林务局和公园管理局都无法控制瓶颈处私人土地上发生的事情。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And with certain other migrating species, the challenge is complicated further - by vastly greater distances traversed, more jurisdictions, more borders, more dangers along the way.
sentences.zh: 对于某些其他迁徙物种来说,挑战更加复杂——穿越的距离更远,管辖范围更多,边界更多,沿途危险更多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: We will require wisdom and resoluteness to ensure that migrating species can continue their journeying a while longer.
sentences.zh: 我们需要智慧和决心,以确保迁徙物种能够继续他们的旅程更长一段时间。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
